map.📚 深度解析：安全防护用品更换周期提醒: 📚 Deep dive: Safety Protection Equipment Replacement Cycle Reminder
map.记录安全帽、防护眼镜、防尘口罩等 8 类 PPE 的领用日期与更换周期，自动算出: Record the issue date and replacement cycle of 8 categories of PPE such as hard hats, safety goggles and dust masks, and the tool automatically computes the next due date and sorts reminders by urgency.
map.周期设为 0（如防毒面具滤盒、手套）表示按需检查，不自动计算到期日，仅纳入检查清: A cycle of 0 (such as respirator filter cartridges or gloves) means inspect as needed with no automatic due date, and only enters the inspection checklist for management.
map.每次检查按清单逐项勾选，记录合格/不合格并留存检查历史，方便后续追溯与定期复核。: At each inspection tick off the checklist item by item, record pass/fail and keep the inspection history for later traceability and periodic review.
map.下次到期日 = 领用日期 + 更换周期(天)；剩余天数 = 下次到期日 − 今天: Next due date = issue date + replacement cycle (days); days remaining = next due date − today. The urgent threshold is urgent = min(max(3, round(cycle×0.1)), 30) days, and the warning threshold is soon = min(max(7, round(cycle×0.2)), 60) days; remaining <0 means overdue, ≤urgent is urgent, ≤soon is coming due, otherwise normal.
map.安全帽周期 913 天（约 30 个月），领用 2025-01-01，则下次到期: A hard hat cycle of 913 days (about 30 months) issued 2025-01-01 is next due 2027-07-02; safety goggles cycle 365 days issued 2026-01-01 next due 2027-01-01; dust mask cycle 30 days issued 2026-08-20 is due 2026-09-19, entering the urgent reminder about 3 days early.
map.为什么有些用品周期设为 0？: Why are some items set to a cycle of 0?
map.防毒面具滤盒、防护手套等按实际损坏或暴露环境更换，无法用固定天数推算到期，故设为: Respirator filter cartridges, protective gloves and similar items are replaced based on actual damage or exposure and cannot be projected to a due date from a fixed number of days, so a cycle of 0 means inspect as needed and the tool only tracks inspection records without predicting due dates.
map.安全帽受过重击但还没到周期怎么办？: What if a hard hat took a severe impact but is not due yet?
map.安全帽壳体出现裂纹或受过重击应立即更换，不论是否到期；可在检查清单标记不合格并记: A hard hat whose shell shows cracks or that took a severe impact must be replaced immediately regardless of the due date; you can mark it as failed in the inspection checklist with a record, then run "Mark as replaced" to reset the issue date.
